scientific_integrity: Proof is symbolic for every finite field. Direct finite computations check selected fields only and are not used as infinite proof. The literature assessment has a stated residual risk of unlocated positive-characteristic classification.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the fixed unital associative algebra \(k[x,y]/(x^2,y^2)\) over finite fields and ordinary alternating k-linear Poisson brackets; no semilinear equivalence, scheme-level statements, unrestricted four-dimensional classification, or independent priority certification.
title: Complete Poisson-orbit classification for a four-dimensional truncated polynomial algebra
